title: 第584章 乐极生悲
content_zh:
凌虚面色一变。

他蓦然环视四方，想要寻找援手。然很快他便发现，福地中的炼炁士全都处于自身难保的境地，无人能够对他施以援手。

此时他三炁离体，元气大损。面对那大魔律令，凌虚只能勉强抵挡。但随着时间的推移，终是渐渐不支。

‘不行，这样下去必败无疑！’

他当机立断

林星辰让林月儿坐在当中的位置，自然是把她当成了亲人。在无穷无尽的世界里，也许每一个平行时空的彼此，都刻印着那些往昔的痕迹。

得知叶优雅最近的生活还不错，赵子龙终于放下了心来。正当他还在回味叶优雅那恬淡的声音时，他的手机再次响了起来。

“夏虎半步结台境，看来夏天龙应该已经突破结台境了！”对于夏家五子，夏铮自然十分清楚，除了夏药擅长丹道之外，其余全部是以实力出众，尤其是夏天龙，更是五子之中排名第一的人物。

随之，是青鳞魔螭的一声痛吼，巨大如山的身体，被巨大的爆破力给震退数米。

“胡说八道，他们都好好地，哪来的病毒，你们这是迫害。”狄风云争辩道。

“我每天担惊受怕的，惟恐哪一天会被踢出市政府大院。一旦这一天到来，我的仕途可就完了，你造么，你造么？”杜京歇斯底里地叫道。

就在他的剑光即将穿过夏铮下体的刹那，却看到夏铮原本漆黑如墨的瞳孔之中，陡然间便的血红一片。

若是换做以前他还不太在意，毕竟他对付不了不是还有钟葵吗，可是现在却是不行，钟葵不但帮不到他的忙，反而还会拖累到他，毕竟他已经不省人事。

“我想你忘了，方寸山是我开启的，我能把你们放出来，就能毁灭你们！”秦羿看着姚胜，冷笑道。

此刻间，琴啸天越是过多的解释，反而起到一定的逆反作用，对方认为琴啸天是在狡辩。从而激起了他心中的得意，更不会就此放过琴啸天了。

眼看来纪云有生命危险，乐异扬顾不了太多，将手中的青云玄空剑用力扔出。通天邪主听到身后划过的长剑声，立即收掌转身避过，并一手夺过宝剑。

“既然无人加价，那么，就以起拍价交给我吧。”曹锋咧嘴一笑，说话间，似乎瞥了一眼秦牧所在处，不过此时的秦牧倒是没有丝毫想要开口的意思。

齐少煊与白问及对视一眼，点头道：“来掌门说得有道理。不过后梁建立之时，不知道有多少百姓无辜而死。这难道不是一场浩劫吗？”齐少煊所在的河北数州，当年曾经血流成河。藩镇对百姓的屠杀，没有一刻放松过。

“是，总管大人！”杨剑又给他磕了一个响头，一脸诚恳的样子，琴啸天看得出，这个胖子杨剑，威慑于胡千钧在蓝冥神族的权力和地位，当然不敢得罪了他。

今天打到件级装备也随便送人，那下次万一打到了高级装备呢？继续送？

“你怎么真的下杀手了……”虽然崇明的实力赵信没有想到，但是对于他杀了公牛子羽这件事赵信还是心有芥蒂，不过又不能说些什么，毕竟双方现在是敌对状态。

看着敖冰菱的样子，萧清封又有种懵像，敖冰菱什么时候这么好说话了。突然之间，萧清封心头有种不踏实感，因为这几日敖冰菱表现的极其贤惠。
content_en:
Ling Xu's expression changed.

He suddenly looked around, looking for help.However, he soon discovered that all the Qi practitioners in the blessed land were in a difficult situation, and no one could help him.

At this time, his three qi energy left his body and his vitality was greatly reduced.Facing the great demonic order, Ling Xu could only resist it.But as time went by, it gradually became exhausted.

‘No, if we continue like this we will definitely fail!’

He made a decisive decision

Lin Xingchen asked Lin Yue'er to sit in the middle position, naturally treating her as a relative.In the endless world, perhaps every parallel time and space has traces of the past engraved on each other.

Zhao Zilong finally felt relieved after learning that Ye Yaya's life was pretty good recently.Just as he was still recalling Ye Yaya's calm voice, his cell phone rang again.

"Xia Hu is halfway to the Formation Stage. It seems that Xia Long should have broken through the Formation Stage!" As for the five sons of the Xia family, Xia Zheng naturally knew very well that except for Xia Yao who was good at alchemy, the rest were all distinguished by their strength, especially Xia Long, who ranked first among the five sons.

Then, there was a painful roar from the blue-scaled demon, and its huge mountain-like body was knocked back several meters by the huge blast force.

"It's nonsense. They are all doing well. Where did the virus come from? You are persecuting them." Di Fengyun argued.

"I am afraid every day that I will be kicked out of the city government compound one day. Once this day comes, my career will be over. Did you do it? Did you do it?" Du Jing shouted hysterically.

Just when his sword light was about to pass through Xia Zheng's lower body, he saw that Xia Zheng's originally dark pupils suddenly turned blood red.

If it were before, he wouldn't have cared much about it. After all, he couldn't deal with Zhong Kui, but now he couldn't. Zhong Kui not only couldn't help him, but would also drag him down. After all, he was already unconscious.

"I think you have forgotten that I opened Fangcun Mountain. If I can release you, I can destroy you!" Qin Yi looked at Yao Sheng and sneered.

At this moment, the more Qin Xiaotian explained, the more counterproductive it was. The other party thought Qin Xiaotian was quibbling.This aroused the pride in his heart, and he would not let Qin Xiaotian go.

Seeing that Ji Yun's life was in danger, Le Yiyang couldn't care too much and threw out the Qingyun Xuankong Sword in his hand.When Tongtian Evil Lord heard the sound of the long sword passing behind him, he immediately turned around to avoid it and grabbed the sword with one hand.

"Since no one has raised the bid, just give it to me at the starting price." Cao Feng grinned and seemed to glance at Qin Mu's place as he spoke, but Qin Mu had no intention of speaking at this time.

Qi Shaoxuan and Bai Wenji looked at each other and nodded: "It makes sense to be the leader. However, when the Later Liang Dynasty was established, I don't know how many people died innocently. Isn't this a catastrophe?" Several states in Hebei where Qi Shaoxuan was located were once filled with blood.The feudal town's massacre of the people never relaxed for a moment.

"Yes, Mr. Steward!" Yang Jian kowtowed to him again, with a sincere look on his face. Qin Xiaotian could tell that this fat man Yang Jian was intimidated by Hu Qianjun's power and status in the Lanming Divine Clan, so of course he did not dare to offend him.

I just gave away piece-level equipment today, but what if I get high-level equipment next time?Continue to send?

"Why did you really kill him..." Although Zhao Xin didn't expect Chongming's strength, Zhao Xin still had a grudge about him killing Niu Niu Ziyu, but he couldn't say anything. After all, the two sides were now hostile.

Looking at Ao Bingling's appearance, Xiao Qingfeng felt confused again. When did Ao Bingling become so easy to talk to?Suddenly, Xiao Qingfeng felt uneasy because Ao Bingling had been extremely virtuous in the past few days.
title_en: Chapter 584 Extreme joy leads to sorrow
